title: State at v0.16.0 and where the current state is recorded
summary: This article is a snapshot. The current figures are always in README.md of the project, with the version they were measured on; sweep.tsv and poke.tsv hold the per-example results.
snapshot: About half of the native entry points are ported (595 of 1,182 at v0.15.0; the month calendar and the DayState classes were added after that count).
Tests: 38 of 38 pass in headless Chromium.

Sweep of the 140 upstream examples at v0.15.0: 72 show their dialog, 7 run to the end, 9 show only a message box, 11 stop at a native not ported, 10 stop on an error (8 of them wait for a reader of binary resources), 24 are components, 7 are outside ooDialog.
done: Dialogs: UserDialog, RcDialog (.rc and .h files), ResDialog through the resource provider, ControlDialog, property sheets and wizards, owned dialogs, message boxes, standard dialogs and routines.

Controls: buttons, check boxes, radio buttons, group boxes, statics, images, edits, list boxes, combo boxes, progress bars, list-views, tree-views, tabs, up-downs, track bars, date-time pickers, month calendars.
Menus: menu bars and popup menus, from scripts and through the resource provider.
Drawing, bitmap buttons and animation, the Mouse class, in-place editing in a list-view, list box tab stops, resizing (ResizingAdmin), tool tips (text), fonts.
File dialogs and shell dialogs over the WASM machine's file system.
not_done: Tool bar, status bar, re-bar; custom draw; scroll bars as controls.
ResizingAdmin's size limits; connectActivate, connectHelp, connectPosChanged, connectResizing (accepted, not produced).
Image-list icons are not drawn; ResourceImage needs images from a binary resource.
A modeless property sheet; wizard header and watermark images.
The CommonDialogCustomizations controls of the shell dialogs.
Printing. The estate's oorexx_pdf package is native ooRexx and is the planned stand-by printer: write a PDF into the WASM file system and offer it for download or the browser's print. Not started.
Not run on a real phone or on the public Playground; the demo page is not hosted.
invariants: When this article and README.md disagree, README.md is right and this article needs a new version.
